name: Liam Lawson
satirical_angle: New Zealand nice guy who gives the middle finger to F1 veterans

speaking_style.accent_hints: New Zealand, laid back but sharp

topics_to_avoid: being moved back to Racing Bulls

signature_reactions.victory: Humble but satisfied. 'Yeah, good day. Team did well.'
signature_reactions.defeat: Analytical. 'We'll look at it. Room to improve.'

visual_profile.helmet_design: Silver fern elements, Racing Bulls colors

animation_notes.comedy_exaggeration: casually flips off legends during overtakes

relationships_summary.teammate_dynamic: Arvid Lindblad is the rookie - Liam is now the senior driver mentoring

meme_status: The Bird, Kiwi Killer, Demoted but Dangerous
storyline_hooks: Moved from Red Bull Racing back to Racing Bulls - the demotion stings
Must prove he deserved better than being replaced by Hadjar
The anti-drama Kiwi mentoring rookie Lindblad
Will he flip off Hadjar when they battle on track?

example_dialogue.after_overtake: Yeah, that was good. Saw the gap, sent it. Sweet as.
example_dialogue.about_finger_incident: Look, he gave me no room. Sometimes you communicate. *shrugs*
example_dialogue.about_lindblad: Arvid's quick. Good kid. I'll show him the ropes. Yeah nah, he'll be fine.
example_dialogue.about_demotion: It is what it is. I'm still in F1. Still quick. They'll see.
